aspect_ratio_conventions.note: Fish 1990 Table III reports the aspect ratio of the pectoral fin (p.395); which span and area enter it is not settled here (fable-to-print v2 flags the same open definition).  Three conventions are computed so a reader can see which one the Table III fit is near.  None of them is fed to the solver by this module; the solver's AR is whatever guilds' model computes from span and area.

body_density_kg_m3.note: Fish 1990 p.399 states body density 'should be close to that of water for buoyancy stability'; 1025 kg/m^3 is a typical seawater density chosen by us, not a measured exocoetid density

body_half_width_max_m.note: from body volume = mass / density and the aesthetic profile

hypocaudal_area_m2.locator: Fish 1990 Table I, Cypselurus hypocaudal-area fit

mass_kg.locator: dx-nca comparison protocol mass (work/nca-glide @ 87e72f9); inside Fish 1990's 0.003-0.53 kg specimens

pelvic_length_over_sl.locator: Daane et al. 2021 Data S1A, 'flying fish | Cheilopogon furcatus' (xlsx sha256 1ac98650f4930362...)
pelvic_length_over_sl.note: median of n=11 specimens, range 0.304-0.500; recomputed from raw lengths

standard_length_m.locator: Fish 1990 Table I, Cypselurus length fit

wing_area_m2.locator: Fish 1990 Table I, Cypselurus wing-area fit x area 1, whole-wing AR x1 (NCA comparison variant)

wing_span_m.locator: Fish 1990 Table I, Cypselurus wing-span fit x area 1, whole-wing AR x1 (NCA comparison variant)

eye_s.note: eye centre as a fraction of SL from the snout

fin_open_radius_mm.note: removes slivers narrower than 0.1 mm; not the print 1 mm opening

fin_thickness_mm.note: flat fin plates; real fin thickness, camber and ray structure not modelled

operculum_phi_deg.note: angle around the body, 0 = dorsal, 90 = left flank

operculum_s_range.note: gill cover extent along the body

scale_lateral_count.note: scales along the lateral series; no Cypselurus count was read

scale_radius_over_spacing.note: radius / centre spacing; > 0.5 makes scales overlap

scale_tilt_deg.note: posterior edge lifted off the body, so each scale overlaps the next

scale_zone_s.note: scaled region along the body (behind the opercula)

label: Engineered illustrative flying-fish form at biological scale. Not an organism, not an ancestor, not a validated aerodynamic shape.

dorsal_anal_fins.note: small vertical fins; excluded from wing area

pectoral_base_fraction.note: fin base chord / max chord (narrow fan base)

ventral_flattening.note: Cypselurus body is 'ventrally flattened' (Fish 1990 p.394, after Breder 1930); the factor is ours

daane2021_pdf.read_level: full-text (main text); data in Data S1A
daane2021_pdf.used_for: pectoral fin allometry fixed across two- and four-wing flying fishes; hypocercal caudal fin with an elongated ventral lobe; S1A fin-length/SL ratios (via engineering.geometry)

status_vocabulary.design_assumption: a modelling choice stated in its note
